title: The Default category stays first with its badge under every sort
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • {Location-A} is connected to QuickBooks, so the Categories list shows the QuickBooks Products And Services column.
  • The Default category {Default-category-A} (for example Uncategorized) shows the Default badge in the Categories list.
  • QuickBooks product or service {Qb-item-A} (for example the item that comes first in the QuickBooks list) exists.
  • QuickBooks product or service {Qb-item-B} (for example the item that comes last in the QuickBooks list) exists.
  • The QuickBooks value shown for {Default-category-A} is neither {Qb-item-A} nor {Qb-item-B}.
  • Category {Category-A} (for example AAA-ZZAUTOTEST-PC33 first) exists, its name coming before the Default category's name, and is mapped to {Qb-item-A}.
  • Category {Category-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC33 last) exists, its name coming after the Default category's name, and is mapped to {Qb-item-B}.
  • You are on a page other than Categories.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Categories in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  3. Read the first row and find {Category-A}.
  4. Click the Name column header.
  5. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  6. Read the first row and find {Category-B}.
  7. Click the QuickBooks Products And Services column header.
  8. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  9. Read the first row and find {Category-A}.
  10. Click the QuickBooks Products And Services column header again.
  11. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  12. Read the first row and find {Category-B}.
  13. Open {Category-A} for editing.
  14. Add the word edited to the end of its name.
  15. Save the dialog.
  16. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  17. Read the QuickBooks header arrow, the first row and find {Category-B}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the first row is {Default-category-A} with its Default badge. {Category-A} is below it, although its name comes before the Default category's name.
  • Step 6: the first row is still {Default-category-A} with its Default badge. {Category-B} is below it, although Z to A would put it higher.
  • Step 9: the first row is still {Default-category-A} with its Default badge. {Category-A} ({Qb-item-A}) is below it.
  • Step 12: the first row is still {Default-category-A} with its Default badge. {Category-B} ({Qb-item-B}) is below it.
  • Step 17: the QuickBooks header arrow still points down, the first row is still {Default-category-A} with its Default badge, and {Category-B} is below it.
  • Steps 3 to 17: every row other than the Default category follows the sort shown by the arrow.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10134 (Story 1, Categories, sort by name; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S1-R19, S1-R20, S1-R21, §5 Terminology 'Default category', read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 1.1 (Categories - before), 1.2 (Categories - after) and 2.1 (The three rules that bite), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Canvas note 'Default rows do not move'. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Price/Category QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R19: “The Default category is always the first row in the list. It holds that position under the Name sort and under the QuickBooks Products and Services sort, in ascending and in descending order alike, and it holds it after a reload in place. When a search term is typed it is first whenever it is among the matching rows; a term that does not match its name leaves it out of the results, as today, and it is never forced into them. This is the behavior the Categories list has in production today and it does not change.”
  • S1-R20: “Every category other than the Default category sorts beneath it, following the rules in S1-R2 through S1-R18. The Default category is not compared against the other rows; it is placed first and the remainder are sorted.”
  • S1-R21: “The Default category keeps its Default badge in every sort.”
  • SV-10134 acceptance criteria: “Given the Name header is clicked, then the order reverses to Z to A, the arrow flips, and the Default category is still the first row.”
  • PRD §5 Terminology: “Default category - the category row named "Uncategorized", which carries the "Default" badge and cannot be edited.”
